sample_sequence_from_coords: sample amino acid sequences from protein backbone coordinates using multinomial sampling with temperature control
build_gvp_transformer_encoder: build a GVPTransformerEncoder from args, source dictionary, and embedding tokens for the inverse folding model
build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder from args, target dictionary, and embedding tokens for sequence generation
build_embedding_layer: build a normalized nn.Embedding layer with padding index for encoder or decoder token embeddings
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the GVP-Transformer model to get logits from coordinates and previous tokens
